newsitem.title: USA: Chico's FAS Jan same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Chico's FAS Jan same-store sales down.

text.p: Chico's FAS Inc Thursday reported total sales of $4.5 million for the five week period ended February 1, 1997, up from $3.7 million for the four week period ended January 28, 1996.
Same-store sales fell 6.9 percent for the five week period of 1997, compared with the comparable five week period of 1996.

Total sales for the 14 week quarter ended February 1, 1997, were $15.0 million, up from $14.2 million for the 13 week quarter ended January 28, 1996. Same-store sales fell 10.6 percent for the 14 week period compared with the comparable 14 weeks of 1996.
Chico's sells exclusively designed private-label women's casual clothing and related accessories.
